ns2:section.sectionText: This course introduces students to the international market for documentaries. The course provides an overview of the documentary process from conception to distribution, and explores the documentary market, its organization and management, including the opportunity to participate in one of the world’s most prestigious markets: Sunny Side of the Doc. Emphasis will be placed on the current state of the industry and emerging trends. Join us in La Rochelle, France June 17 – 23, 2017. Registration is due February 1, 2017.
